title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 18
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pillar width' in board and pillar mining depends on
options: Depth, strength of coal, and roof conditions
questions.solution: Pillar width depends on depth, coal strength, and roof conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support installation' in a drift must be done
options: As soon as possible after excavation, before the next round
questions.solution: As soon as possible after excavation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine water pumping record' must be maintained by
options: The person responsible for pumping operations
questions.solution: The person responsible for pumping operations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main danger from electrical equipment in coal mines is
options: Ignition of methane or coal dust by sparks or heat
questions.solution: Ignition of methane or coal dust by sparks or heat.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'extraction sequence' in depillaring determines
options: Order of pillar extraction for safety and subsidence control
questions.solution: Extraction sequence determines safe pillar removal order.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'levelling instrument' in mine surveying is used to determine
questions.solution: Determines difference in elevation between points.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'auxiliary fan' is used to
questions.solution: Auxiliary fans supplement ventilation in specific areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An accident investigation team should include
options: Competent persons including safety officer and workers' representative
questions.solution: Competent persons including safety officer and workers' representative.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be tested for
options: Load capacity and safety before carrying passengers
questions.solution: Load capacity and safety before carrying passengers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'total station' in mine surveying combines
options: Angle measurement, distance measurement, and data recording
questions.solution: Angle measurement, distance measurement, and data recording.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The inflow of water into a mine can be detected by
options: A change in the wind direction
Sudden increase in pump load, wet spots, or change in water quality
A change in the roof colour
questions.solution: Sudden increase in pump load, wet spots, or change in water quality.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'overbreak' in drifting is
options: Excavation beyond the designed drift profile
questions.solution: Overbreak is excavation beyond the designed profile.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'pilot raise' is driven to
options: Establish a raise connection between two levels
A small cross-cut for ventilation only
questions.solution: Establishes a raise connection between two levels.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An explosive charge is used in face drilling to
options: Fragment coal or rock for easier loading
questions.solution: Fragments coal or rock for easier loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rock bolting' for drift support is installed
options: As the drift advances, following the face
questions.solution: Rock bolts are installed as the drift advances.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'development to extraction ratio' in bord and pillar must be
questions.solution: Balanced for continuous production.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'slope monitoring instrumentation' includes
questions.solution: Slope monitoring uses inclinometers, extensometers, piezometers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stone dust barriers are designed to
options: Be triggered by the explosion pressure wave
questions.solution: Designed to be triggered by the explosion pressure wave.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'flood gate' in a mine is used to
options: Improve the ventilation of a section
Support the roof of a gallery
Isolate sections in case of water inrush
questions.solution: Isolates sections in case of water inrush.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must have a signaling system that is
options: Audible only at the pit bottom
questions.solution: Clearly audible and visible.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'stopping' in mine ventilation is a permanent wall to
options: Provide fresh air to working faces
questions.solution: Blocks airflow completely.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The cross-sectional area of the roadway affects
options: The quantity of stone dust required for dusting
questions.solution: Affects the quantity of stone dust required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A flameproof enclosure can withstand
options: Internal explosion without allowing it to escape to the surrounding atmosphere
questions.solution: Internal explosion without allowing it to escape.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'booster fan' is used to
options: Assist the main fan in boosting air pressure in a section
questions.solution: Assists the main fan in boosting air pressure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The load on a man riding rope must not exceed
options: The safe working load as designed
questions.solution: The load must not exceed the designed safe working load.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'shift report' should be written
options: At the end of each shift
questions.solution: At the end of each shift.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Every mine plan or section under CMR 2017 shall show:
options: The true north, or the magnetic meridian with the date of the latter
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(1)(b): plans show true north or magnetic meridian and the date of the later.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Regulation 65 of CMR 2017, every mine must have
options: Accurate and up-to-date plans and sections as prescribed
questions.solution: Regulation 65 (Type of plans) requires the owner, agent or manager of every mine to keep the prescribed plans and sections.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must maintain a record of
options: Persons employed, time of work, and safety conditions
questions.solution: Records include persons employed, work time, and safety conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A water dam in a mine is constructed to
options: Impound water and prevent it from entering working areas
questions.solution: Impound water and prevent it from entering working areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'Chief Inspector' has the power to
options: Cancel or suspend certificates of competency
questions.solution: Cancel or suspend certificates of competency.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act, the 'Inspector of Mines' is appointed by
options: The Central Government or State Government
questions.solution: Appointed by the Central Government or State Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system operating in a gassy mine must use
options: A dumper with an open cab
questions.solution: Intrinsically safe or flameproof vehicles.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Plans and sections required under CMR 2017 shall be corrected and maintained up-to-date at intervals not exceeding:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(4): plans are kept corrected up-to-date not earlier than 3 months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'swing radius' of excavators must be
questions.solution: Swing radius must be clear of personnel and equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'non-electric detonator' or 'shock tube' system is used because
options: It is safer near electrical equipment and lightning
questions.solution: Safer near electrical equipment and lightning.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Mine fires can be classified as
options: Fires of the first and second class
Fires of the third and fourth class
questions.solution: Mine fires are classified as surface and underground fires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine house must be
questions.solution: Fireproof and properly ventilated construction is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gob' in mining is another term for
options: Goaf - the area where coal has been extracted
questions.solution: Goaf - area where coal has been extracted.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'possible reserve' of coal is
questions.solution: Possible reserves are suggested by limited exploration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A junction box in a mine must be
options: Flameproof or intrinsically safe as per the zone classification
questions.solution: Flameproof or intrinsically safe per zone classification.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ultimate analysis' of coal determines
options: Carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, sulfur, oxygen content
questions.solution: Ultimate analysis determines C, H, N, S, O content.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue station' must have
options: Trained personnel and equipment for emergency response
questions.solution: Rescue stations must have trained personnel and equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'sump' in a mine is used to
options: Collect water for pumping to surface
questions.solution: Collects water for pumping to surface.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'pack wall' in stowing is used to
options: Retain stowing material in the goaf
questions.solution: Retains stowing material in the goaf.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Unless otherwise approved, mine plans and sections under CMR 2017 shall be prepared on a scale with a representative factor of:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 64(1)(d): plans are on a scale with RF 2000:1 or 1000:1, with a scale bar at least 25 cm long.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'CO2 flooding' in mines is used to
questions.solution: CO2 flooding inert atmosphere to extinguish fires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'coal basin' is a
questions.solution: A coal basin is a large depression with coal deposits.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The interval between two consecutive shifts in a mine must be at least
questions.solution: At least 8 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum roadway length at which stone dust barriers are installed is
questions.solution: At intervals of approximately 100 meters.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'strata failure report' should include
options: Location, nature of failure, possible cause, and remedial measures
questions.solution: Location, nature, cause, and remedial measures.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must not allow any person to
options: Enter or work in a place he is not authorized
questions.solution: No person shall enter or work in an unauthorized place.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per DGMS Circular 2/2010, strata and dump slope monitoring is mandatory for dumps exceeding ______ in height.
questions.solution: DGMS Circular 2/2010: monitoring (including slope stability radar / real-time monitoring) is made mandatory for dumps exceeding 60 m height.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Water accumulation on benches creates hazards including
options: Reduced traction, slope instability, equipment damage
questions.solution: Water accumulation causes multiple hazards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'windrow' along bench edge serves as
options: Safety barrier to prevent vehicles going over edge
questions.solution: Windrows act as safety barriers at bench edges.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safe distance' for persons during blasting depends on
options: The charge weight and type of explosive used
The length of the drill steel
questions.solution: Charge weight and type of explosive.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety lamp room' in a mine must be under the control of
options: A competent person authorized by the manager
questions.solution: A competent person authorized by the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The protection of electrical equipment in mines includes
options: Earth leakage protection, short circuit protection, and overload protection
questions.solution: Earth leakage, short circuit, and overload protection.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main difficulty of hydraulic stowing in steep seams is
options: Gravity causes uneven distribution of material
questions.solution: Gravity causes uneven distribution.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'gradient' of a roadway is calculated from
options: Rise or fall divided by horizontal distance
questions.solution: Gradient is rise/fall divided by horizontal distance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'rescue equipment testing records' must be
options: Maintained with dates, results, and corrective actions
questions.solution: Testing records must be maintained with dates and results.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The person in charge of a man riding system must maintain a
options: Log book of operations, defects, and maintenance
questions.solution: A log book of operations, defects, and maintenance is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hydraulic transport' in stowing uses
options: Pumps and pipelines to move slurry
questions.solution: Pumps and pipelines to move slurry.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water dam design' considers
options: Water pressure, ground conditions, and drainage provisions
questions.solution: Dam design considers pressure, conditions, and drainage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Carbon monoxide (CO) in mines is produced by
options: Incomplete combustion of explosives, fires, and machinery exhaust
questions.solution: Incomplete combustion of explosives, fires, and machinery exhaust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'advancing longwall' method involves
options: Extracting coal from the shaft area towards the boundary
Extraction from the boundary towards the shaft
A method used only in metal mines
questions.solution: Extracting coal from shaft area towards boundary.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, the manager must report a fatal accident to
questions.solution: The Chief Inspector must be notified within 24 hours.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding incline must have
options: Adequate means of escape in case of rope failure
questions.solution: Adequate means of escape are required in case of rope failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'bearing' of a line in surveying refers to
options: Angle of the line with reference direction
questions.solution: Bearing is the angle of a line with a reference direction.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'incident reporting system' in a mine must be
options: Easy to use and encourage reporting without fear of blame
questions.solution: Easy to use and encourage reporting without fear of blame.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system using battery-powered vehicles must have
options: Flameproof or intrinsically safe electrical equipment
questions.solution: Flameproof or intrinsically safe equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'gas ignition report' must include
options: Type of gas, concentration, source of ignition, and extent of damage
The attendance of the surface staff
questions.solution: Type, concentration, source, and extent of damage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The stone dust used for stone dusting must contain
options: At least 80% calcium carbonate or equivalent incombustible material
questions.solution: At least 80% calcium carbonate or equivalent incombustible material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'inundation report' must mention
options: Source of water, rate of inflow, and measures taken to control it
questions.solution: Source, rate, and measures taken.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The capacity of a SDL is typically
questions.solution: Typically 2-4 tonnes per trip.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The pressure wave from a coal dust explosion can
options: Travel ahead of the flame and pre-ignite dust
questions.solution: Travels ahead of the flame and pre-ignites dust.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The advantage of a continuous miner over conventional method is
options: Higher production, less manpower, and improved safety
questions.solution: Higher production, less manpower, and improved safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Before each shift, the man riding system operator must
options: Carry out a test run before carrying passengers
questions.solution: A test run must be carried out before carrying passengers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the working place is
questions.solution: The working place must be properly examined before work begins.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'water dam inspection frequency' should be
options: Regular and increased during rainy season
questions.solution: Dam inspection should be regular, increased during rainy season.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal bed methane' (CBM) production in India is from
options: Coal seams in Gujarat, Jharkhand, and other states
questions.solution: Coal seams in Gujarat, Jharkhand, and others.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The synonym of 'Precaution' is
questions.solution: Precaution means safety measure.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'international coal market' prices are benchmarked by
questions.solution: Newcastle and other international indices.

questions.stem: The compound interest on ₹10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years is

questions.stem: The 'coal quality parameters' include
options: Calorific value, ash, moisture, sulfur, and size
questions.solution: Quality parameters include CV, ash, moisture, sulfur, size.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine lease' in India is granted for a period of
questions.solution: Mine leases in India are typically granted for 30 years.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal sector environmental compliance' includes
options: Air, water, noise monitoring and waste management
questions.solution: Air, water, noise monitoring and waste management.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'roadway' in underground mining is driven for
options: Transport, ventilation, and access to working faces
Storing of coal on the surface
questions.solution: Transport, ventilation, and access to working faces.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: India's first satellite was named
questions.solution: Aryabhata was India's first satellite.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'NCL' (Northern Coalfields Limited) is located in
questions.solution: NCL is located in Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The national bird of India is
questions.solution: Peacock is the national bird.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Green India Mission' aims to
questions.solution: Increase forest and tree cover.

questions.stem: The 'fuel supply agreement' (FSA) between CIL and power plants ensures
options: Assured coal supply for power generation
questions.solution: Assured coal supply for power generation.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine rescue stations' in India are maintained by
questions.solution: CIL and state governments.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal bunker' in a mine is used to
options: Store coal before dispatch or use
questions.solution: Stores coal before dispatch or use.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine mechanization' in India has improved because of
options: Rise in the number of workers
Introduction of continuous miners, longwall, and surface miners
questions.solution: Introduction of continuous miners, longwall, and surface miners.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'National Infrastructure Pipeline' (NIP) involves
options: Rs 111 lakh crore investment in infrastructure
questions.solution: Rs 111 lakh crore investment.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine safety culture' in India has improved due to
options: Better training, technology, and regulatory enforcement
questions.solution: Better training, technology, and enforcement.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Transfer) Act' deals with
options: Acquisition of coal bearing areas for mining
questions.solution: The Act deals with acquisition of coal bearing areas.
